title: Ten commitments for a bold biotechnology industry - Nature Biotechnology
text:
As biotechnology becomes one of the defining technologies that will shape economic strength, national resilience and geopolitical influence over the coming decades, the industry must commit to rebuilding and preserving public trust in the face of growing pressures on the institutions that underpin scientific leadership.
